Herrmann, 8 th Gerard J. Gorman. Devito is an open-source Python project based on domain-specific language and compiler technology. Driven by the requirements of rapid HPC applications development in exploration seismology, the language and compiler have evolved significantly since inception.

arxiv-2201-05042.title: Edge magnetism in transition metal dichalcogenide nanoribbons: Mean field theory and determinant quantum Monte Carlo
arxiv-2201-05042.creator: Francisco M. O. Brito, Linhu Li, João M. V. P. Lopes, Eduardo V. Castro
arxiv-2201-05042.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Francisco M. O. Brito, Linhu Li, João M. V. P. Lopes, Eduardo V. Castro. Edge magnetism in zigzag transition metal dichalcogenide nanoribbons is studied using a three-band tight-binding model with local electron-electron interactions. Both mean field theory and the unbiased, numerically exact determinant quantum Monte Carlo method are applied. Depending on the edge filling, mean field theory predicts different phases: gapped spin dimer and antiferromagnetic phases appear for two specific fillings, with a tendency towards metallic edge-ferromagnetism away from those fillings.

arxiv-2203-03851.title: Holographic Local Operator Quenches in BCFTs
arxiv-2203-03851.creator: Taishi Kawamoto
arxiv-2203-03851.description: Abstract We present a gravity dual of local operator quench in a two-dimensional CFT with conformal boundaries. This is given by a massive excitation in a three-dimensional AdS space with the end of the world brane (EOW brane). Due to the gravitational backreaction, the EOW brane gets deformed in a nontrivial way.

arxiv-2206-06985.title: Spin-density, charge- and bond-disproportionation wave instability in hole-doped infinite-layer R R NiO 2
arxiv-2206-06985.creator: K. G. Slobodchikov, I. V. Leonov
arxiv-2206-06985.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by K. G. Slobodchikov, I. V. Leonov. Using ab initio band structure methods and DFT+dynamical mean-field theory approach we explore the possible formation of spin and charge stripes in the Ni-O plane of hole-doped infinite-layer nickelates, R R NiO 2 . Our results reveal a remarkable instability of the C C -type ( 110 ) (110) spin state with undistorted lattice towards the formation of the spin-density, charge- and bond-disproportionation stripe phases accompanied by in-plane“breathing”-like distortions of the crystal structure.

arxiv-2207-13564.title: Yielding in multi-component metallic glasses: Universal signatures of elastic modulus heterogeneities
arxiv-2207-13564.creator: Kamran Karimi 1, Mikko J. Alava 1,2, Stefanos Papanikolaou 1
arxiv-2207-13564.description: Abstract Sheared multi-component bulk metallic glasses are characterized by both chemical and structural disorder that define their properties. We investigate the behavior of the local, microstructural elastic modulus across the plastic yielding transition in six Ni-based multi-component glasses, that are characterized by compositional features commonly associated with solid solution formability.

arxiv-2402-00509.title: Precise SMEFT predictions for di-Higgs production
arxiv-2402-00509.description: Abstract We present results of precision calculations for di-Higgs production that combine NLO QCD corrections with operators at canonical dimension six within Standard Model Effective Field Theory (SMEFT). We discuss possible options for operator contributions within a given EFT framework and sources of theory uncertainties.

arxiv-2403-18916.title: Modelling the Raft Distributed Consensus Protocol in mCRL2
arxiv-2403-18916.creator: Parth Bora Pham Duc Minh Tim A.C. Willemse
arxiv-2403-18916.description: Abstract The consensus problem is a fundamental problem in distributed systems. It involves a set of actors, or entities, that need to agree on some values or decisions. The Raft algorithm is a solution to the consensus problem that has gained widespread popularity as an easy-to-understand and implement alternative to Lamport’s Paxos algorithm.

arxiv-2406-06613.title: GameBench : Evaluating Strategic Reasoning Abilities of LLM Agents
arxiv-2406-06613.creator: Anthony Costarelli, Mat Allen, Roman Hauksson, Grace Sodunke, Suhas Hariharan, Carlson Cheng, Wenjie Li, Joshua Clymer, Arjun Yadav
arxiv-2406-06613.description: Abstract Large language models have demonstrated remarkable few-shot performance on many natural language understanding tasks. Despite several demonstrations of using large language models in complex, strategic scenarios, there lacks a comprehensive framework for evaluating agents’ performance across various types of reasoning found in games.

arxiv-2407-09327.title: Sina at FigNews 2024: Multilingual Datasets Annotated with Bias and Propaganda
arxiv-2407-09327.creator: Lina Duaibes Birzeit University 1205358@student.birzeit.edu Areej Jaber Palestine Technical University-Khadoorie a.jabir@ptuk.edu.ps Mustafa Jarrar Birzeit University mjarrar@birzeit.edu Ahmad Qadi 7amleh Center ahmad@7amleh.org Mais Qandeel ÖREBRO University Mais.Qandeel@oru.se
arxiv-2407-09327.description: Abstract The proliferation of bias and propaganda on social media is an increasingly significant concern, leading to the development of techniques for automatic detection. This article presents a multilingual corpus of 12,000 12,000 Facebook posts fully annotated for bias and propaganda.

arxiv-2409-09075.title: A Systematic Procedure for Topological Path Identification with Raw Data Transformation in Electrical Distribution Networks
arxiv-2409-09075.creator: Maurizio Vassallo 1 , Alireza Bahmanyar 2 , Laurine Duchesne 2 , Adrien Leerschool 2 , Simon Gerard 3 , Thomas Wehenkel 3 , Damien Ernst 1 4
arxiv-2409-09075.description: Abstract This paper introduces a systematic approach to address the topological path identification (TPI) problem in power distribution networks. Our approach starts by listing the DSO’s raw information coming from several sources. The raw information undergoes a transformation process using a set of transformation functions. This process converts the raw information into well-defined information exploitable by an algorithm.

arxiv-2410-01280.title: Sparse Autoencoders Reveal Temporal Difference Learning in Large Language Models
arxiv-2410-01280.creator: Can Demircan, Tankred Saanum, Akshay K. Jagadish, Marcel Binz, Eric Schulz
arxiv-2410-01280.description: Abstract In-context learning, the ability to adapt based on a few examples in the input prompt, is a ubiquitous feature of large language models (LLMs). However, as LLMs’ in-context learning abilities continue to improve, understanding this phenomenon mechanistically becomes increasingly important.

arxiv-2501-00543.description: Abstract . This paper addresses the Corona problem for slice hyperholomorphic functions for a single quaternionic variable. While the Corona problem is well-understood in the context of one complex variable, it remains highly challenging in the case of several complex variables.

arxiv-2505-11130.title: A Direct Diabatic States Construction Method with Consistent Orbitals for Valence and Rydberg States
arxiv-2505-11130.creator: Jiamin Jin, Zexing Qu, Chungen Liu
arxiv-2505-11130.description: Abstract This work presents a novel methodology termed Direct Diabatic States Construction (DDSC), which integrates fragment wavefunctions into an anti-symmetric wavefunction for the entire system. Using a fragment-localized state-consistent molecular orbital (FL-SC MO), this approach enables direct construction of all diabatic states at the same root.

arxiv-2505-12562.title: On generalized harmonic quasiconformal Koebe functions
arxiv-2505-12562.creator: Zhi-Gang Wang, Jia-Le Qiu and Antti Rasila
arxiv-2505-12562.description: Abstract . This paper studies a class of generalized harmonic quasiconformal Koebe functions. It is motivated by the shear construction of Clunie and Sheil-Small [Ann. Acad. Sci. Fenn. Ser. A I Math. 9: 3–25, 1984] and the harmonic quasiconformal Koebe function.

arxiv-2506-19919.title: Bayesian Posteriors with Stellar Population Synthesis on GPUs ⋆ E-mail:gzacharegkas@anl.gov
arxiv-2506-19919.creator: Georgios Zacharegkas 1,⋆, Andrew Hearin 1, Andrew Benson 2
arxiv-2506-19919.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Georgios Zacharegkas 1,⋆, Andrew Hearin 1, Andrew Benson 2. Models of Stellar Population Synthesis (SPS) provide a predictive framework for the spectral energy distribution (SED) of a galaxy. SPS predictions can be computationally intensive, creating a bottleneck for attempts to infer the physical properties of large populations of individual galaxies from their SEDs and photometry; these computational challenges are especially daunting for near-future cosmology surveys that will measure the photometry of billions of galaxies.

pmc-11384987.title: Predicting factors of blood pressure normalization in hypertensive patients after short-term follow-up
pmc-11384987.creator: Fatouma Sall, Gueu Christophe Meneas, Balayssac Ahou Edwige Siransy, Marie-Paule N’cho Mottoh, Yannik-Hermann Kpi, Ismael N’guessan, Vierge Marie Assi, Florent Diby, Anicet Adoubi
pmc-11384987.description: IntroductionNormalization of blood pressure in hypertensive patients is a major challenge for practitioners. Knowledge of the factors associated with normalization of blood pressure could help optimize management of these hypertensive patients. In this study, we analysed the factors predictive of this in a population of hypertensive patients followed as outpatients in a specialised department.

pmc-11494293.title: Biochemical and structural insights into a 5’ to 3’ RNA ligase reveal a potential role in tRNA ligation
pmc-11494293.creator: Yingjie Hu, Victor A. Lopez, Hengyi Xu, James P. Pfister, Bing Song, Kelly A. Servage, Masahiro Sakurai, Benjamin T. Jones, Joshua T. Mendell, Tao Wang, Jun Wu, Alan M. Lambowitz, Diana R. Tomchick, Krzysztof Pawłowski, Vincent S. Tagliabracci
pmc-11494293.description: SignificanceATP-grasp enzymes share an atypical ATP-binding fold and catalyze a diverse set of reactions involved in many essential cellular processes. We identified C12orf29 (RLIG1) as an atypical ATP-grasp enzyme. Our biochemical and structural characterizations revealed this enzyme to be a 5’ to 3’ RNA ligase, structurally and functionally similar to phage T4 RNA ligase.

pmc-11636053.title: Targeting RTKs/nRTKs as promising therapeutic strategies for the treatment of triple-negative breast cancer: evidence from clinical trials
pmc-11636053.creator: Kasshish Mehta, Mangala Hegde, Sosmitha Girisa, Ravichandran Vishwa, Mohammed S. Alqahtani, Mohamed Abbas, Mehdi Shakibaei, Gautam Sethi, Ajaikumar B. Kunnumakkara
pmc-11636053.description: The extensive heterogeneity and the limited availability of effective targeted therapies contribute to the challenging prognosis and restricted survival observed in triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC). Recent research indicates the aberrant expression of diverse tyrosine kinases (TKs) within this cancer, contributing significantly to tumor cell proliferation, survival, invasion, and migration.

pmc-12373421.title: Thoracic paravertebral osteosarcoma induced by radiotherapy for esophageal cancer: A case report
pmc-12373421.creator: Bin Chen, Li Zhao, Lujiao Chen, Wan Sun, Jun Yu, Jin Xu
pmc-12373421.description: With the wide application of radiation therapy for malignant tumors and the continuous improvement of comprehensive treatment effect, the survival period of patients has been prolonged, while the incidence of radiation-induced osteosarcoma (RIOS) has gradually increased. Compared with primary osteosarcoma, RIOS has a higher degree of malignancy and poorer prognosis, severely impacting patient survival.

pmc-12528588.title: Triple Air Leak Syndrome in Cannabinoid Hyperemesis: A Diagnostic Challenge Managed Conservatively
pmc-12528588.creator: Kashif Ali, Aresha Masood Shah, Arsalan Hyder, Valeska Balderas
pmc-12528588.description: Cannabinoid hyperemesis syndrome (CHS) is a condition marked by recurrent nausea, vomiting, and abdominal pain in chronic cannabis users. Rarely, severe vomiting can lead to complications such as spontaneous pneumomediastinum, pneumopericardium, and pneumoretroperitoneum. We present a case of a 21-year-old woman with CHS who developed a rare triad of spontaneous pneumomediastinum, pneumopericardium, and pneumoretroperitoneum.

pmc-12604594.title: Targeting ANXA4 to Overcome Cisplatin Resistance in Ovarian Cancer: A Bioinformatics and in Vitro Study
pmc-12604594.creator: Yong Wang, Qingzhen Xie
pmc-12604594.description: BackgroundOvarian cancer is a leading cause of gynecologic cancer-related deaths, with cisplatin (DDP) resistance posing a significant challenge to effective treatment. Understanding the molecular mechanisms underlying DDP resistance is crucial for developing new therapeutic strategies.This study aimed to explore the molecular mechanisms of DDP resistance in ovarian cancer, focusing on identifying key genes involved in this process.

pmc-13246063.title: Consistency in staging, grading, and extent of periodontitis diagnosis: A cross-sectional online-based assessment among Indonesian periodontics specialist students
pmc-13246063.creator: I.Komang Evan Wijaksana, Nova Andriani Hepitaria, Irma Josefina Savitri, Shahabe Saquib Abullais, Saad AlQahtani, Ghadah Khaled Bahamdan
pmc-13246063.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Periodontitis remains a significant global health burden, and its accurate diagnosis is critical for effective management. The 2018 classification system for periodontitis introduces staging, grading, and extent parameters to enhance diagnostic consistency, but its application among trainees remains underexplored. This study evaluates the consistency of staging, grading, and extent diagnosis of periodontitis among Indonesian periodontics specialist students using the 2018 classification system, highlighting challenges and variability in interpretation.

pmc-13450251.title: Shifting risk profiles in the systemic-to-focal transition of brucellosis: a multicenter analysis of spondyloarthritis development
pmc-13450251.creator: Meng Zhao, Xuefeng Luo, Abudusalamu Alimujiang, Junru Liao, Junchao Ma, Jian Guo, Xi Wang, Jun Zhang, Ziyi Xu, Qiyu Jia, Chuang Ma
pmc-13450251.description: BackgroundBrucellar Spondyloarthritis (BrSpA), a common and disabling complication of brucellosis, often develops as the disease transitions from its acute systemic phase. However, the specific risk factors and clinical patterns heralding this shift are poorly understood. This study aimed to identify stage-dependent risk factors for BrSpA and to elucidate the paradoxical clinical signs associated with its development.

pmc-13599259.title: PDLSC-CM targets HAPLN1 in macrophages to reduce root resorption in delayed replanted teeth
pmc-13599259.creator: Lu Jia, Zengbo Zhao, Ying Zhang, Liping Zhang, Yan Liu, Hongyu Ma, Peng Zhang, Xiangdong Liu, Lu Zhang, Hang Yang, Zihan Yang, Zhe Ma, Huimin Wang, Zhiyong Hou, Huijie Ma
pmc-13599259.description: BackgroundTooth avulsion is the most serious dental trauma, mainly affecting anterior teeth in adolescents. Delayed tooth replantation is the most common situation in clinical, but root resorption is a common complication that can lead to tooth loss. As implant is not feasible in adolescents, strategies to mitigate root resorption remain a major challenge in dentistry.
